items.title: Business Recruiter
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that keep the company running and bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter to join our Talent team in London to own full-cycle recruiting for either our G&A functions (Finance, Legal, People, and related areas) and our Go-To-Market organization (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer-facing roles), depending on business need and your background. This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run. We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting or in GTM recruiting; in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest. Key Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A or GTM roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions Minimum Qualifications 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in either G&A (Finance, Legal, People) or GTM (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships) hiring Track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets Familiarity with the EMEA talent landscape and comfort recruiting across multiple countries Strong stakeholder management—you build trust and partnership with hiring managers Excellent organization and the ability to manage multiple searches at once without dropping details Clear, direct communication style and a bias toward action Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment Genuine interest in Anthropic’s mission and the role recruiting plays in achieving it Preferred Qualifications Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £105,000 — £105,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Staff/Principal Developer Advocate
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. THE ROLE... Synthesia's API and platform capabilities are quickly becoming the way developers embed AI video into their own products — automated training pipelines, localization workflows, customer-facing apps, and more. We're looking for our first Developer Advocate to make sure the developer world knows it, understands it, and gets building. This is a builder-and-storyteller role. You'll be the face and voice of the Synthesia API to the outside world — writing, coding, speaking, and showing up wherever developers already are — while also being the internal champion who brings their feedback back into the product. You won't just talk about what's possible with Synthesia; you'll build the sample apps, tutorials, and demos that prove it, and you'll do it consistently enough that developers start to recognize your name before they recognize the logo. You'll be part of the Developer Services team and work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Developer Support to turn technical capability into developer adoption. WHAT YOU'LL DO Create technical content that developers actually use - Write blog posts, tutorials, and how-to guides that show real, working integrations — not just feature announcements - Build and maintain sample apps, starter kits, and code snippets across common languages and frameworks - Produce video walkthroughs and livestreams using Synthesia's own product wherever it makes sense to "eat our own dog food" - Keep a fast, honest cadence — regular, dependable output builds more trust than occasional big launches Show up where developers are - Represent Synthesia at conferences, meetups, hackathons, and webinars — as a speaker, workshop host, and booth presence - Run livestreams and community AMAs that go deep on real implementation questions, not marketing talking points - Build relationships with individual developers, technical bloggers, and community leaders who influence adoption - Travel as needed to be physically present in the communities that matter most to our growth Be the credible technical voice - Get hands-on with the Synthesia API well enough to build things yourself, debug alongside developers, and speak with authority — not from a script - Earn trust the way any evangelist does: by being genuinely useful before asking for anything in return - Play the long game — plant seeds in developer communities today that turn into adoption months or years down the line Close the loop with product - Channel developer feedback, friction points, and feature requests back to Product and Engineering in a structured way - Partner with Developer Support and Documentation to identify where the API's rough edges are creating support burden or lost adoption - Help prioritize the developer experience roadmap based on what you're hearing on the ground Build the flywheel - Grow and nurture channels — Discord/Slack community, developer newsletter, social — where developers can find each other and find help - Identify and cultivate community advocates and early power users who can become case studies, co-speakers, or contributors - Measure what's working (content engagement, API sign-ups, community growth, sentiment) and adjust the playbook accordingly ABOUT YOU... - Experience in developer relations, developer advocacy, technical evangelism, or a similar hybrid technical/communication role — ideally at a platform, API-first, or infrastructure company - Genuinely hands-on: comfortable writing code, working with APIs and SDKs, and building demo apps yourself, not just narrating what engineering built - A strong, authentic communicator across formats — written, live, and on stage — who can make technical concepts land with a developer audience - Comfortable with regular travel and public speaking; energized by meeting developers in person, not just online - A track record of sustained output (blog, video, or community content) rather than one-off campaigns — evangelism is a long game, and consistency is what earns trust - Skilled at listening as much as broadcasting: you can sit in a developer's frustration and turn it into a clear, actionable signal for the product team - Comfortable operating with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, still-forming function - Bonus: existing following or credibility within a developer community relevant to Synthesia's platform (video, AI/ML, automation, or enterprise software) THE GOOD STUFF.. In addition to being a part of a great team, working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer: - A competitive salary + stock options in our fast-growing Series E startup - Hybrid working environment or remote friendly - 100% Medical, Dental & Vision - 401k Plan - Paid parental leave - 25 days of annual leave + Public holidays + paid sick leave - Fun culture with regular socials - A generous referral scheme - A brand new computer + monitor - Budget and support for conference travel, community events, and content production

items.title: IT Support Engineer
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an IT Support Engineer based out of our New York office. This is a hybrid role - 4 days per week on-site and one day working from home. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Device lifecycle management: assist with laptop procurement, setup, returns, and secure wiping - Office IT support: provide on-hand support to our colleagues in our New York office, as well as support with expansions and/or office buildouts - AV support: ensure meeting rooms and AV equipment are running reliably - End-user support: be the first point of contact for the team by logging, prioritising and resolving support tickets in a timely manner, keeping end users informed throughout. - Onboarding: run IT onboarding calls for new joiners - New IT projects: contribute to IT initiatives - Automation and tooling: build automations and Slack bots to streamline repetitive work - Documentation: write and maintain clear internal IT documentation and guides (fixes, processes and playbooks) to continue building out our internal knowledge base WHAT YOU BRING - A friendly, end-user focused attitude. You genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems. - Strong organisational skills, attention to details and a proactive mindset. - Solid IT fundamentals (macOS, iOS and Android Operating systems, networking basics, SaaS tooling, AV systems etc.) - Hands-on experience with an MDM platform (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or similar) - Experience with Okta (or similar IdP) and understanding of access management principles, SSO, MFA and user/group management. - A willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly - Clear written and verbal communication skills with a knack for writing helpful documentation. BONUS - Prior experience in a high growth / startup environment - Experience in a customer or public-facing role - Experience with Agentic AI tooling - Familiarity with bash scripting WHAT WE OFFER At ElevenLabs, our biggest reward is shaping that future of voice technology. In addition, we offer: - Stock options; we want you to have ownership in the company and share the successes that lie ahead. That’s why we offer early employees stock options as part of their compensation package. - Extraordinary team; we favor ambitious, smart people striving for outsized impact. You’ll work on the state of the art surrounded by people with extraordinary skills and positive attitudes. - We offer competitive compensation and stock options. We are open to candidates of varying seniority. items.title: Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency. Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization. In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic - Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication - Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows - Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes - Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time - Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results - Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems - Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment - Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD - Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards - Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders - You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document - A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics - Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English NICE TO HAVES - Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications - Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack - Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning - Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring - Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection - Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements. Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers. Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant. Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization. Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner. Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner. A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in both English and German is required. Any additional language skills are a strong plus. Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk). Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? items.title: Head of Enterprise Risk Management
items.description: About the Team The OpenAI Risk & Audit team is building an enterprise risk capability for a company operating at the frontier of AI. We help leaders identify, understand, and manage the risks that matter most while enabling responsible innovation and durable growth. We are developing a modern enterprise risk management (ERM) program and the technology foundation that powers it. Our work connects risk strategy, governance, compliance, and assurance with high-quality data, automated workflows, continuous monitoring, and AI-enabled analysis. We partner across Finance, Security, Legal, Engineering, Product, People, Operations, and Internal Audit, and provide clear reporting to senior leadership and the Board. We aim to make risk ownership practical, decision-useful, and embedded in how OpenAI builds and scales. About the Role As the Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will help build and lead an integrated ERM program and the ERM platform that supports it. You will establish common risk language, governance, and decision processes while translating them into scalable systems, data products, and workflows. You will own enterprise risk assessments, maintain a centralized risk register, develop risk appetite and key risk indicators, and help leaders evaluate significant changes such as new products, markets, partnerships, major systems, and strategic investments. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hands-on leader who will build our ERM capability from the ground up, with the potential to build and lead a team over time. You will work with technical and business teams to connect source systems, improve data quality, automate evidence and control monitoring, and use AI to surface emerging risks and accelerate analysis. You will also help create a strong risk culture, coordinate assurance across the three lines, and communicate complex issues with clarity and sound judgment. This is an opportunity to build a next-generation capability from the ground up. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Design and evolve OpenAI’s enterprise risk management framework, including risk taxonomy, governance standards, risk appetite, escalation thresholds, and mitigation expectations. - Lead enterprise risk assessments and maintain a centralized, decision-useful risk register that reflects strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, compliance, and emerging risks. - Establish key risk indicators, continuous-monitoring capabilities, and executive dashboards that translate complex data into clear signals, trends, and actions. - Enable risk-informed change governance for new products, markets, partnerships, acquisitions, major systems, and other high-impact initiatives. - Lead effective governance forums working cross-functionally with key partners such as Compliance, Finance, Security and others, and prepare concise reporting for senior leadership and the Board. - Define the strategy and roadmap for a modern ERM platform that will connect with systems across the enterprise including identity, finance, HR, ticketing, code, and others through reliable integrations and shared data models. - Apply automation, policy-as-code, data analytics, and AI-assisted workflows to evidence collection, control monitoring, issue management, risk analysis, and audit or regulatory responses. - Coordinate risk activities across Finance, Security, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Internal Audit, clarifying ownership and reducing duplication across the three lines of defense. - Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team, strengthen first-line ownership, and foster a culture of practical risk management, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 12+ years of experience across enterprise or operational risk, compliance, internal audit, security governance, finance, or related fields, including significant experience leading ERM or GRC programs. - A track record of building or materially scaling an enterprise risk program in a fast-growing, technology-driven, or otherwise complex global organization. - Strong command of ERM and assurance practices, including risk appetite, risk assessments, KRIs, controls, issue management, and the three-lines model; familiarity with frameworks such as COSO or ISO/IEC 27001/27017/27018/27701/42001. - Experience advising executives and presenting risk information to senior governance bodies, with the judgment to make complex tradeoffs clear and actionable. - Technical fluency with GRC platforms, data architecture, APIs, system integrations, cloud environments, and automated workflows; experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, or policy-as-code is a plus. - Experience using data analytics, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve risk sensing, evidence analysis, control monitoring, and reporting. - The ability to connect strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, and compliance risks and to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. - Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary teams while operating effectively in ambiguity and at high velocity. - A relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; credentials such as CIA, CPA, CISA, CRMA, CRM, or an advanced business, legal, or technical degree are valued. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. Our product teams work across research, engineering, product, data, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to people and businesses around the world. Design plays a critical role in making powerful AI intuitive, useful, and trustworthy. We hold a high bar for quality and build experiences that earn users’ confidence, while moving quickly and learning from real-world feedback. We favor early validation and continuous refinement over waiting until every detail is perfect. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Designer to shape how startups, small businesses, and growing teams discover, adopt, and unlock lasting value from ChatGPT. You’ll own growth experiences across the customer journey, turning the potential of AI into meaningful, everyday impact for people across the world. This is a highly hands-on role for a designer who pairs exceptional craft with strong product judgment and an experimental mindset. You’ll tackle some of our most interesting growth challenges, using creativity, product intuition, and experimentation to discover new opportunities. We’re looking for someone who loves treating metrics as puzzles to solve, finding unexpected solutions, and learning quickly through iteration. Above all, you bring exceptional design craft and believe that driving measurable impact and building beautiful, intuitive experiences should go hand in hand. This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Own end-to-end design for growth experiences across ChatGPT - Design and improve experiences across user lifecycle stages like discovery, onboarding, activation, engagement, collaboration, conversion, and retention. - Turn ambiguous opportunities into clear hypotheses, compelling prototypes, and polished product experiences. - Set a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, systems thinking, content, and end-to-end coherence. - Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market teams to shape both strategy and execution. - Use quantitative data, experimentation, research, and qualitative insights to identify opportunities and evaluate outcomes. - Translate complex and rapidly evolving AI capabilities into approachable experiences for people with a wide range of technical expertise. - Move fluidly between longer-term product vision and fast, iterative execution. - Contribute reusable patterns and insights that strengthen growth experiences across ChatGPT. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Benefits team helps attract, support, and retain the people advancing our mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. As part of the People team, we deliver benefits and experiences for a rapidly growing employee population in and outside the US. We partner across People, Payroll, HR Systems, Legal, and external providers to help employees navigate important moments with clear guidance and reliable support. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Leaves & Accommodations Analyst to support the day-to-day administration of OpenAI’s leave of absence and workplace accommodations programs. You will coordinate assigned cases from intake through closure, keep records and documentation organized, and support accurate, timely handoffs across the teams involved. This is a hands-on, employee-facing role for someone who enjoys careful execution and helping people understand what comes next. You’ll follow established policies and workflows, take responsibility for routine case tasks, and recognize when a complex, sensitive, or unclear request needs guidance from the appropriate case owner. You will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Payroll, HR Systems, third-party administrators, and other members of the Benefits team. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Global Leave & Accommodation. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Coordinate assigned leave cases. Support intake, documentation follow-up, case tracking, return-to-work coordination, and closure for U.S. and international requests, including medical, parental, and statutory leaves. Use established workflows and seek guidance when requirements are unclear. - Help employees navigate the process. Provide clear, empathetic updates about required information, timelines, and next steps. Respond to routine employee and manager questions using approved guidance, and route questions outside your scope to the right partner. - Support the accommodations process. Organize required information, coordinate follow-ups, and document approved next steps for ergonomic, disability-related, and religious accommodations. Handle medical documentation only through approved confidential channels. Escalate eligibility questions, policy exceptions, legal requirements, and accommodation determinations to the appropriate case owner. - Keep case records accurate. Maintain leave and accommodations data in HRIS and case-tracking systems. Complete routine checks, investigate discrepancies with the appropriate partners, make approved updates, and support audits or testing with HR Systems. - Prepare reliable payroll handoffs. Check approved case and pay information, including company-paid time off, statutory benefits, vendor-reported events, and company top-ups. Flag discrepancies and cutoff risks promptly, and confirm that agreed corrections are completed. - Coordinate work across partners. Track outstanding actions with third-party administrators, vendors, HR Business Partners, Payroll, and HR Systems. Make next steps and handoffs clear, follow up on open items, and keep the case owner informed of blockers. - Stay on top of deadlines and requests. Keep case trackers current, prioritize routine work against established deadlines, and raise competing priorities or urgent employee needs to your manager early. - Improve day-to-day execution. Identify recurring issues and suggest practical changes to checklists, templates, and documentation. Help implement approved improvements that reduce errors and make the process easier for employees and partners. items.title: AI Engineer - Data and Evals
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: The bottleneck in building reliable, useful AI is no longer writing code. It's defining what good looks like and measuring how well our products deliver it. That takes high-quality data and evals that teams can trust. Our team owns data and evaluation science for Glean's AI products. We build evalsets, agentic LLM-judges, and benchmarks that capture what good looks like, along with the platform and infrastructure that run evals reliably at scale, and enterprise simulation environments where we test how our assistants and agents actually perform. Starting from real production usage, you'll turn what we learn into evals that guide improvements across the entire stack, from agent harnesses to tool use, skill iteration, model routing, and post-training of task specific models. You'll bring new research into production and partner with R&D, product, and GTM to turn findings from evals into better products and customer outcomes. If you care about quality and want to build the systems that measure it, this role is for you. You will: Build evalsets and benchmarks from expert-curated examples, production data, synthetic data, and past failures, covering edge cases and key user slices. Build and scale the eval platform and agent observability: experiment pipelines, trace capture and replay, and dashboards, with reproducible, affordable runs. Build agentic LLM verifiers for correctness, groundedness, citation quality, and task success, and calibrate them against human labels using clear rubrics. Run evals at every stage, from CI and pre-release suites to sampled production traffic, and report results with confidence intervals. Build enterprise simulation environments with simulated users and realistic company data to test multi-step agent tasks. Diagnose failures by slice and trace, and turn eval results into concrete fixes, weighing quality against latency and cost. About you: 5+ years of software engineering experience with strong Go and/or Python and backend fundamentals: APIs, data modeling, testing, and distributed pipelines. TypeScript is a plus. Experience building datasets and benchmarks for LLM use-cases, RAG, or agents, including evalset curation and synthetic data generation. Familiarity with eval methodologies and their tradeoffs: deterministic metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, pointwise vs pairwise grading, human labeling, and judge calibration. Experience building eval or experiment infrastructure that runs reliably at scale, including CI/CD integrations and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry. Strong analytical skills: you dig into traces and failure cases, write SQL, and use data and metrics to explain why quality moved. Nice to have: experience with simulation environments and/or model post-training techniques. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $280,000 annually. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. You'll own the execution of complex privacy assessments for new products and features, drive issue remediation, and build scalable processes that embed privacy by design into how Coinbase ships. items.description: Semrush is a brand visibility platform, empowering marketers to command their online presence and create measurable impact. We unify SEO authority and AI visibility, so brands are found, cited, and chosen everywhere search happens. That’s how Semrush gained the trust of over 28 million users—from scaling startups to Fortune 500 companies. Some highlights of our success: $470M+ Annual Recurring Revenue with AI products surpassing $38M+ Dollar-based net revenue retention of 104%, as of December 31, 2025 Large deals growing 74% YoY Semrush named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Search Engine Optimization Solutions, Q3 2025 Exceptional demand for the Enterprise platform, with deals with global giants like JP Morgan, LG, Samsung, TikTok, and others Shared ambition makes a bigger impact. That’s why at Semrush, progress is a partnership: You push us forward, we push you further—and we all move as one. Are you ready to be part of this journey? About the opportunity The Sales team is at the forefront of empowering businesses to achieve online visibility and digital marketing success. Through our selling approach and world-class enablement programs , we equip our team with the tools, resources, and training. This is how we keep delivering meaningful results for our customers. Joining the Sales team also means: Fast forward and continuous career growth: the highest rate of promotions within the organization A team spread across 40+ locations around the globe Offline and online bootcamps as part of our onboarding process President’s club—an opportunity to celebrate exceptional results and reward top performers in high-class vacation destination Quota attainment has been recognized as higher than market average , according to RepVue Uncapped commissions About your future tasks We are hiring an exceptional Global Customer Success Leader to build and scale a high-performing, commercially accountable organization serving Semrush’s largest and most strategic enterprise customers. Reporting to the Chief Sales Officer of Semrush and partnering with Regional Vice Presidents of Sales , this leader will own the global CS strategy, operating model, leadership development and performance, with accountability for adoption, value realization, retention, renewals and expansion. This is not a Support or Professional Services role. We need a product-deep, commercially driven leader who builds exceptional teams, engages credibly at C-suite level and translates Semrush and Adobe Brand Visibility capabilities into measurable business impact. Our customers don't simply buy technology; they invest in outcomes. The mandate is to make Customer Success a strategic growth engine, connecting our platform, data and insights to executive priorities and turning customer value into durable, profitable growth. The Mandate Accelerate time-to-value and measurable business outcomes. Deepen adoption and maximize platform value. Drive retention and predictable renewals. Unlock expansion through demonstrated customer impact. Elevate executive engagement and strategic partnerships. Build one globally consistent CS operating model with exceptional leadership, talent and execution. This leader will own the enterprise customer journey from closed-won through value realisation and renewal readiness, driving accountability across Enterprise Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Support, Professional Services, RevOps, Enablement and Adobe field teams. Key Priorities 1. Build one global Enterprise CS operating model Define how Enterprise CS should operate globally across regions, account tiers, product lines, and customer complexity. Install consistent operating rhythms across onboarding, adoption, customer health, renewal readiness, executive engagement, and risk management. Create clarity on what good looks like: what CSMs own, what Sales owns, what Renewals owns, when SE or Professional Services gets involved, and how we engage executives at the right moments. 2. Shorten time-to-value Own the customer journey from closed-won through first measurable value. Every enterprise customer should have a clear success plan tied to what they bought, why they bought it, who needs to adopt it, and what outcome they expect. Build onboarding standards by product and customer complexity. Set expectations early, remove friction quickly, and ensure customers realize value with speed and confidence. 3. Drive deeper product adoption Raise the bar for how Enterprise CSMs understand and drive adoption across the broader Semrush portfolio. This team needs to be product-deep enough to understand workflows, use cases, adoption blockers, stakeholder gaps, and where customers are not getting the value they should. The goal is not activity. The goal is adoption connected to customer outcomes. 4. Improve retention and renewal readiness Build a disciplined Enterprise renewal readiness motion in partnership with Sales and Renewals. Improve visibility into customer health, adoption quality, risk, executive alignment, and value realization well before renewal. Create clear risk categories, save plans, escalation paths, and executive engagement standards. No surprises. No late risk discovery. No renewal conversations without a clear view of value. 5. Elevate executive customer engagement Move QBRs and EBRs from usage reviews into strategic business conversations. Enterprise customers should understand how Semrush helps them answer bigger questions: what is working, what is not, where to invest, where competitors are winning, how customer journeys are changing, and how visibility connects to action. This leader will raise the quality of executive engagement across the Enterprise CS team. 6. Build strong cross-functional operating discipline This role sits at the center of Customer Success, Enterprise Sales, Renewals, Product, Solutions Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Enablement, RevOps, and Adobe field teams. The right leader will create clean handoffs, clear ownership, and strong operating discipline across the post-sale customer journey. They will also make sure customer feedback becomes actionable input for Product, GTM, Enablement, and leadership. About you Required Experience Proven leadership of Enterprise Customer Success teams in a SEO, AI visibility, brand visibility, content, competitive intelligence, data solutions, analytics, or broader marketing technology. Experience owning time-to-value, adoption, customer health, retention, and renewal readiness. Strong enterprise customer fluency: executive engagement, complex stakeholders, multi-product adoption, global accounts, and strategic business reviews. Deep product orientation, with comfort going below the surface into workflows, use cases, adoption barriers, and value realization. Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to balance customer advocacy, retention, expansion partnership, and revenue accountability. Operating discipline across scorecards, inspection cadence, customer health, renewal risk, and executive reporting. Experience leading managers and scaling a global or multi-region CS organization. Clear communication and executive presence, with the ability to simplify complexity across teams, customers, and regions. Professional Traits (your bar) Excellent Judgment - high-quality, timely decisions with incomplete data; owns outcomes. Hire & Develop the Best - raises the bar; builds managers as force multipliers. High Standards - precision in pipeline, forecast, messaging, and execution. Strategic + Hands-On - ability to effortlessly toggle between strategic direction-setting and operational rigor, with a skew towards action. Innovator’s Bias - turns market trends and customer pain into product and GTM plays. Ambitious & Conviction-Driven - sets bold goals; mobilizes teams to beat them. Results-Oriented - grit and tenacity - measures what matters; celebrates outcomes, not activity. Inspirational Leadership - creates clarity, energy, and momentum across regions. All thanks to 1700+ employees who build the company every day. About our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion commitments Semrush is an equal opportunity employer. Propose, lead and contribute to security initiatives that reduce risks across the Data domain and your assigned business domain. Collaborate with the wider Security organization, including the Blue and Red Teams, as well as Compliance and Fraud teams. Why join this role? Bring your software development experience to practical application security challenges. Help teams implement meaningful security improvements, rather than stopping at recommendations. Develop broad expertise across application security, data security, secure software engineering and business domains. items.title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE MISSION You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters. Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure. You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond. Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end. Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand). - Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas. - Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on. - Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors. - Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills. - Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers, and respect for the people depending on the cluster. ABOUT YOU - Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting. - Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship. - Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness. - Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement. - Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment. - Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations. - Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites. EVEN IF YOU DON'T MATCH EVERY CRITERION Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching. NICE TO HAVE - HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance. - Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics. - Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems. - Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Member of Data Staff (Data Acceleration)
items.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. This role brings that same standard to how our data team works, with AI at the center of everything we do. We're looking for someone who's been a great data scientist, analytics engineer, or data engineer: the kind of person who knows which metric actually matters, can design an A/B test that answers the real question, has gone deep on a data model because something didn't add up, and has decided that the highest-leverage thing they can do next is build AI systems that fundamentally change how data science gets done. You'll build AI agents and internal systems that can increasingly handle end-to-end analysis workflows: forming hypotheses, writing and running queries, interpreting results, and drafting recommendations with the right evaluation, review, and guardrails. You'll build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let AI systems query the warehouse reliably. You'll create workflows that detect, diagnose, and help fix data issues before they become company-wide problems. You'll build the infrastructure that multiplies what a small data team can ship. You'll join a data team that's already using AI across its work. The next step is turning those individual workflows into scalable systems, shared tools, and an AI-native operating model that becomes a benchmark for how modern data teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build AI agents that do data science - not just SQL copilots, but systems that can safely explore data, form hypotheses, run queries, interpret results, and generate actionable recommendations with clear evaluation and human review loops. - Make AI systems query the warehouse reliably - build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let agents use our semantic context and metadata accurately. - Accelerate the AI-native data workflow - turn the best existing AI-assisted workflows into repeatable systems, reusable tools, and patterns the whole data team can adopt. - Automate the data lifecycle - build self-healing pipelines, automated dbt model generation and validation, data quality agents, and diagnosis workflows that reduce manual firefighting. - Ship AI-powered experiment analysis - build agents that interpret A/B test results, flag statistical issues, identify likely drivers, and draft ship/no-ship recommendations. - Turn the data team into a product team - build internal data products that stakeholders use every day, replacing ad hoc requests with self-serve AI interfaces. - Own the full lifecycle - identify high-leverage problems, prototype with LLMs, evaluate accuracy, design the UX, ship to production, and monitor quality over time. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in data science, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. You've been close enough to real data work to know what should and should not be automated. - Deep SQL and analytics judgment - you can reason through metrics, experiments, data models, and messy warehouse reality without relying on a tool to think for you. - Strong product sense - you understand what stakeholders actually need, what makes a workflow adoptable, and how to turn a prototype into a product people use. - Hands-on LLM experience - you've built with frontier models, agents, RAG systems, evals, or AI-powered workflows and have opinions about where they work and where they fail. - Pipeline and modeling fluency - you've worked with dbt, warehouse schemas, data quality issues, and the practical tradeoffs behind durable data systems. - Builder mentality - you see a manual process and immediately think about how to systematize it. You ship fast, measure quality, and iterate. - Autonomy - this is a new function. You'll help define the roadmap as much as execute it. BONUS - Experience building production AI agents or agent evaluation systems. - Experience with Snowflake, semantic layers, or metadata systems. - Experience building internal tools, Slack bots, CLIs, or developer productivity products that people actually used. - Strong experimentation background, including metric design and statistical interpretation. - Experience with BI tools and the judgment to know what should be automated versus kept human-reviewed. - Early-stage startup experience. WHY THIS ROLE - Set the standard for the industry - Perplexity's data team is already using AI across its work. You'll turn that into something other data teams look to as the benchmark. - Build AI with AI - Perplexity builds AI for people who expect more. You'll bring that same level of ambition to how the company works with data. - Frontier models, day one - you're at an AI company with access to frontier infrastructure and people who deeply understand what's possible. - Massive leverage - the systems you build will multiply the output of every data team member and every stakeholder who needs data. - Direct impact - small team, no layers of approval. Idea to shipped system in days, not quarters.

items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Advisor Products team is bringing Trade PMR, Robinhood's newly acquired registered investment advisor platform, into the Robinhood product suite. Our multiyear mission is to connect Robinhood's growing retail customers with Trade PMR's financial advisors, while bringing together two sets of technology and user experiences into one coherent product. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and partners in marketing and finance who care about getting this integration right for customers on both sides. We're energized by the scope of this work and the chance to shape how two strong businesses come together! As a Staff Web Engineer on this team, you'll build and scale full-stack systems, spanning backend services and web applications that support Advisors and Investors. You'll take on system design work, reasoning through tradeoffs to produce architecture that holds up as the integration between Trade PMR and Robinhood grows, and you'll stay hands-on, writing code while also setting technical direction. You'll partner with product, marketing, and finance stakeholders to turn open-ended requirements into concrete technical plans, and you'll coach and review other engineers' work to raise the bar on quality and process across the team. You'll have an initial focus on integrating "growing good" retail customers with Trade PMR advisors. Create system and technical designs that hold up at scale, and reason through tradeoffs with your team before committing to an approach. Partner with other engineering teams, product, marketing, and finance stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans. Coach and review other engineers' work, helping raise the bar on code quality, design rigor, and delivery practices. Define mechanisms to ensure best practices are applied in our development cycle. Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including customers when needed, about progress and tradeoffs. What you bring 10+ years of professional engineering experience, with several years at the staff level and prior Team Lead experience Hands-on experience building and scaling web systems, with strength in React, TypeScript, and Node, plus proficiency in Go and Python. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Connector Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them. We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve tool quality as models evolve. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a product-minded Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction, build the systems behind plugins, and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll lead complex initiatives across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release. You’ll remain hands-on while driving product and design decisions alongside Product, Design, Research, and engineering partners. You’ll help shape what we build and how it works, translate user and developer needs into clear priorities, and guide technical decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term reliability and maintainability. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Set technical direction and lead complex initiatives across the Plugin Ecosystem, aligning architecture and execution across teams. - Drive product and design decisions with cross-functional partners, helping define priorities and shape intuitive experiences for users and developers. - Design and ship APIs, SDKs, and services that developers use to extend ChatGPT and Codex. - Build intuitive experiences that help users discover, install, and use plugins to get more done. - Make plugins easier to create, test, publish, update, and share. - Improve when and how models use plugins, from choosing the right plugin to completing a task. Work with Research to diagnose failures and measure improvements as models evolve. - Improve plugin reliability and interaction quality across ChatGPT and Codex, including interactive apps, with clear error messages and recovery paths. - Build consistent permissions, approvals, and admin controls that help individuals and organizations confidently adopt plugins. - Work with developers and partners to turn recurring problems into improvements to the platform, tooling, and documentation. - Collaborate across engineering, Product, Research, Security, and Trust & Safety to scale plugin infrastructure and deliver safe, reliable execution. - Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, thoughtful code reviews, and clear technical guidance. items.title: Partner Enablement Lead, Beneficial Deployments
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team brings Claude to organizations doing some of the world's most important work across the nonprofit and education sectors. These organizations share a problem: mission-critical work, thin budgets, and little slack to figure out new technology on their own. Our Customer Success team helps them go from first login to Claude being part of how their teams work, but we cannot do that one organization at a time, nor should we. The sector already has trusted intermediaries these organizations turn to first: networks, capacity builders, funder technical assistance providers, community colleges, and fellowship programs. This role exists to make those intermediaries as effective at activating and training organizations on Claude as our own Customer Success team is. As the Scaled Enablement Lead, you'll build the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program that qualifies intermediaries to onboard organizations and deliver Anthropic-designed workshops on our behalf. You'll own the kits, credentials, and quality gates that let them run the show without an Anthropic CSM in the room. You'll also own the enablement thinking behind scaling impact through Claude Corps : how what fellows learn and build serves every organization we support, not only the ones that host them. The people you enable are not selling Claude. They are trainers, implementers, and program staff whose job is to help mission-driven organizations meaningfully adopt AI. Your job is to make sure these intermediaries can do that with Claude, to the same bar we hold ourselves to, and to help them evolve their offerings as we learn what these organizations need. The measure of success for this role is organizations activated and trained well without Anthropic delivering it. You'll be half program builder, half facilitator. You'll design and deliver the first cohorts yourself, then make the system repeatable: kits, qualification paths, credentials, teach-back gates, and a refresh rhythm that keeps content current as our products change. You'll build on the operating model and certification infrastructure of Anthropic's Education team and own everything specific to this audience, working closely with Beneficial Deployments Customer Success, Partnerships, Claude Corps program leadership, and our Education teams. This is not a partner account management or alliances role, and it carries no quota. It is not a book-of-business Customer Success role either, though you'll spend time with organizations to stay grounded in what these nonprofits truly need. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. At Kraken, compliance is not a checkbox. It's a core expression of who we are and how we operate. Our Global Sanctions Compliance function sits at the intersection of regulatory accountability and technology, building processes that don't just meet the standard but set it. We're looking for people who bring both sharp regulatory judgment and a builder's mindset to the table. We're looking for a Sr. Compliance Associate Lead, Sanctions Operations to join us fully remote. This role reports directly to Kraken's Chief Sanctions Officer and sits at the heart of how we review, escalate and resolve sanctions risk across Kraken's global footprint. You'll work the escalations generated by our sanctions controls and by our first line of defence, focusing on the complex sanctions risks that matter most, and you'll help us make the operation faster and more scalable as volumes grow. THE OPPORTUNITY - Perform sanctions reviews in response to escalations generated across Kraken, from blockchain monitoring, name screening and transaction screening to anti-circumvention controls and account sign-up and maintenance rules - items.title: Head of Retention
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and retention is one of the most important unsolved problems in the business. Traders come in for elections, crypto moves, and playoff runs, then go quiet. The gap between a one-time depositor and an active, long-term trader is where this role lives. You will build and lead the team that closes it. The retention org today is early. You will design the structure, make the hiring calls, and build the operating model from the ground up, including lifecycle, CRM operations, retention analytics, and incentives. You will manage through managers, own the incentive P&L with Finance, and be the voice of the retained trader in executive forums. This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. The playbook does not exist yet. This hire matters because retention is now a company-level priority, not a marketing function. Active-trader retention and LTV are going into the company scorecard. The person in this role will sit in leadership reviews, shape product roadmaps, and make the call on where incentive dollars go. If you have built a retention org at a high-churn consumer business, know how to run incrementality tests, and want to work on a product that is genuinely hard to retain users on, this is the job. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build the retention organization from an early-stage team into a full function, including lifecycle, CRM operations, analytics, and incentives, and make the calls on when to hire, what to build in-house, and what to bring in from partners. - Own active-trader retention at 30, 90, and 180 days and LTV growth as company-level KPIs, and report cohort performance, churn signals, and incentive ROI directly to the CEO and exec team. - Set and defend the retention incentive budget with Finance, using incrementality data to make the hard calls on when spend is and is not worth it. - Align Markets, Growth, Product, and Brand around a single coordinated plan for major event moments, including elections, playoffs, and crypto events, so acquisition and retention move together. - Negotiate roadmap commitments from Engineering and Data for the triggers, tooling, and data infrastructure the retention team needs to operate, including Braze, Customer.io http://Customer.io, and Amplitude. - Own messaging rules across the company, including frequency caps and channel priority, to resolve competing demands for user attention and protect the trader experience. - Work with Legal and Compliance as a peer to set retention guardrails covering CFTC rules, state eligibility, and contact permissions, so the team can move fast inside clear limits. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10 or more years in retention, lifecycle, or CRM, with at least 5 years leading teams and direct experience managing managers. - A track record of building or scaling a retention org at a high-churn consumer business, in sports betting, fintech, streaming, or a comparable category. - Experience owning an incentive or retention budget with full ROI accountability, including presenting incrementality results to Finance and executive leadership. - Strong analytical judgment: you can challenge a model, design or read an incrementality test, and explain the results clearly to people who are not specialists. - Experience presenting to and influencing a C-suite on retention strategy, not just reporting metrics. - Experience leading in a regulated industry, with working knowledge of compliance constraints on user communications and promotions. - Genuine interest in markets, sports, politics, or crypto, because the product is event-driven and the team needs to care about what traders care about. - (Plus) Direct background in sports betting or prediction markets, with familiarity with how bettors churn and what actually brings them back. - (Plus) Experience operating in a CFTC-regulated or similarly regulated environment. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories
